events.body:
## Context

`scripts/generate_leaderboard.py` (about L57) uses `### URL\s*\n\n(\S+)`, so `"### URL\r\n\r\nhttps://a.com"` and `"### URL\nhttps://a.com"` both return None. Reports with CRLF or one missing blank line drop out of "Top reported domains".

## What to do

1. Use `### URL[ \t]*\r?\n\s*(\S+)` or normalise `\r\n` first.
2. Add cases to `tests/test_generate_leaderboard.py`, plus tests for `extract_first_image`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] LF, CRLF and single-newline bodies yield the domain
- [ ] New tests pass

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-pages
```
